title: Rihanna Shares Adorable New Photos & Videos of Daughter Rocki After 1st Birthday
summary: "Who let me have a daughter, bro?" the superstar joked in the caption.
contentText:
Rihanna is giving fans another glimpse into life with her youngest child.

The 38-year-old Fenty mogul and mother of three took to Instagram on Saturday (Sept. 26) to share a series of adorable photos and videos featuring her 1-year-old daughter with A$AP Rocky , Rocki Irish Mayers.

The sweet gallery opens with Rocki tugging at a large wig placed on her head as Rihanna can be heard laughing in the background. In another photo, the toddler sports pink hair curlers, similar to those her dad is often seen wearing.

In one video, Rihanna takes a Louis Vuitton bag away from Rocki, prompting the toddler to cry before her mom gives it back. And in another clip, Rocki wears a generous amount of Fenty Beauty blush alongside her mom.

“Who let me have a daughter, bro?” Rihanna captioned the post.

The “We Found Love” singer’s partner, A$AP Rocky, took to the comments to show some love to his baby girl. “MY FATTY BUMS,” the rapper wrote alongside a red heart emoji.

Rihanna welcomed her third child on Sept. 13, 2025, with A$AP Rocky, with whom she also shares sons RZA and Riot Rose. The couple announced less than two weeks later on Instagram that Rocki had arrived.

Before Rocki’s arrival, Rihanna revealed she was expecting again by debuting her baby bump on the 2025 Met Gala red carpet. The couple kept the baby’s sex under wraps ahead of the birth, though they were open about hoping for a girl, with Rocky telling Elle in 2024 that they were “praying for a girl.”

Rocki made her official entry into the modeling world in April, joining her famous mom on the cover of W Magazine at just 7 months old. “She outshined me,” the singer joked at the time . “Last shoot we’ll ever do together. Who’s the high-fashion baby?”
